hebrewText: וַ/תֵּ֨לֶד ל֜/וֹ אֲח֣וֹת תַּחְפְּנֵ֗יס אֵ֚ת גְּנֻבַ֣ת בְּנ֔/וֹ וַ/תִּגְמְלֵ֣/הוּ תַחְפְּנֵ֔ס בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בֵּ֣ית פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֤י גְנֻבַת֙ בֵּ֣ית פַּרְעֹ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י פַרְעֹֽה

tokens.bdb: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
tokens.kjv: bear, beget, birth(-day), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, calve, child, come, be delivered (of a child), time of delivery, gender, hatch, labour, (do the office of a) midwife, declare pedigrees, be the son of, (woman in, woman that) travail(-eth, -ing woman).

tokens.bdb: a sister (used very widely (like brother), literally and figuratively)
properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)

tokens.bdb: to treat a person (well or ill), i.e. benefit or requite; by implication (of toil), to ripen, i.e. (specifically) to wean
tokens.kjv: bestow on, deal bountifully, do (good), recompense, requite, reward, ripen, [phrase] serve, mean, yield.
